Question: Do breaks in the emission path coincide with policy changes?
Hypothesis: H1: an endogenous break lies within ±1 year of 2010 (Food Harvest 2020) or 2015 (quota abolition)
Primary test: Bai–Perron structural breaks with bootstrap UDmax
Supported if: UDmax p < 0.10 and a break date within ±1 year

Question: Did intensity gains keep pace with scale growth?
Hypothesis: H2: intensity offset IO < 1 after 2015 (efficiency did not keep pace)
Supported if: IO < 1 across the range of dairy emission factors

Question: Did production pressure offset mitigation?
Hypothesis: H3a: θM < 0 (mitigation lowers emissions); H3b: θP > 0 (pressure raises emissions); H3c: offset ratio ≥ 0.5
Primary test: ARDL long-run multipliers, restricted block bootstrap, dynamic counterfactuals
Supported if: One-sided bootstrap p < 0.10; for H3c, the 90% interval of the pressure effect excludes zero

Question: Do effects differ by instrument type and by regional exposure?
Hypothesis: H4a: mandatory instruments have the largest negative effect; H4b: more dairy-exposed regions expanded more after 2015
Supported if: p < 0.10 with the predicted sign; placebo not significant
